## Problem

What's missing or annoying? What are you trying to do that the app doesn't support?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Scope note

This project uses a spec-driven workflow ([spec-kit](https://github.com/github/spec-kit)) —
substantial features go through `/speckit-specify` → `/speckit-plan` → `/speckit-tasks` rather
than being implemented ad hoc. A good feature request here becomes the seed for that spec; it
doesn't need to be fully speced out itself.
